sampler.distribution: Each item: key is an equal-weight (1:1:1) oneof of (a) named keys {a, b, "", __proto__, constructor, toString, hasOwnProperty}, (b) printable ASCII 0..16, (c) binary-ascii 0..16; value is a biased integer in [-1000, 1000]. array length 0..32 via fast-check biased integer sizing (size: "max"). Shrinking stays inside the chosen key branch.

contractVerdictGuide: Leave contractVerdict null until you adjudicate by hand. A returned-value discrepancy is not a confirmed candidate violation. Suggested values: candidate-violation, reference-bug, ambiguous-contract, not-a-violation.

replay.note: Replay runs the saved candidate again. It does not call Ollama and it does not change the candidate file.
